sql-service.name: cs.com.user_select
sql-service.query: SELECT A.USER_ID ,A.USER_NAME ,A.USER_GRADE_CD -- 사용자등급코드 (참고:코드북 SYS001) ,A.USER_GRADE_NM USER_GRADE_NM ,A.USER_GROUP_CD ,A.PASSWORD ,'' PWD_CHG_DATE ,A.PWD_ERR_CNT , A.USE_YN ,'' SOCIAL_ID , A.EMP_NO ,'' ENTER_DATE ,'' RETIRE_DATE , LEVEL_CD ,'' LEVEL_NAME , FUNCTION_CD ,'' FUNCTION_NAME , JOB_CD ,'' JOB_NAME ,'' WORK_GROUP_CD ,'' WORK_GROUP_NAME ,A.DEPT_CD ,A.DEPT_NM , ORG1_CD , ORG1_NAME , ORG2_CD , ORG2_NAME , ORG3_CD , ORG3_NAME ,ISNULL((SELECT ETC1 FROM MS_CODEBOOK WHERE CODE_TYPE = 'SCH999' AND CODE_ID = '01'), '0800') WORK_STIME ,ISNULL((SELECT ETC2 FROM MS_CODEBOOK WHERE CODE_TYPE = 'SCH999' AND CODE_ID = '01'), '2000') WORK_ETIME , CONVERT(varchar , getdate(), 112) CURRDATE ,(SELECT CODE_NAME FROM MS_CODEBOOK WHERE CODE_TYPE = 'SYS010' AND CODE_ID = 'G_URL') G_URL ,'' CONNECT_IP ,'' REG_DATEE ,'' REG_TIME ,(SELECT ETC3 FROM MS_CODEBOOK WHERE CODE_TYPE = 'SCH999' AND USE_YN='Y' ) MIN_SORTNO ,(SELECT ETC4 FROM MS_CODEBOOK WHERE CODE_TYPE = 'SCH999' AND USE_YN='Y' ) MAX_SORTNO FROM vw_usermaster A WHERE UPPER(A.USER_ID) = ?userid AND (A.USE_YN = 'Y' )

sql-service.name: cs.com.expired_select
sql-service.query: select code_name from cs_codebook where code_type=?codetype and code_id = ?codeid

sql-service.name: cs.com.password_errorcnt
sql-service.query: UPDATE MS_USERMASTER SET PWD_ERR_CNT = ?pwd_err_cnt WHERE EMP_NO = ?userid

sql-service.name: cs.com.logout_checklog
sql-service.query: SELECT LOGIN_DATE, LOGIN_TIME FROM ms_login_log WHERE USER_ID = ?user_id AND LOGOUT_DATE = '' AND LOGOUT_TIME = '' AND LOGIN_YN = 'Y' ?was_ip

sql-service.name: cs.com.logout_insertlog
sql-service.query: UPDATE ms_login_log SET LOGOUT_DATE = CONVERT(varchar(8),GETDATE(),112) , LOGOUT_TIME = REPLACE(CONVERT(varchar(8),GETDATE(),108),':','') , LOGIN_YN = 'N' , CHG_ID = ?USER_ID , CHG_DATE = format(GETDATE(),'yyyyMMddHHmmss') WHERE USER_ID = ?USER_ID AND LOGOUT_DATE = '' AND LOGOUT_TIME = '' AND LOGIN_YN = 'Y'

sql-service.name: cs.com.auth_menu.sel
sql-service.description: 로그인 후 권한에 따른 메뉴 조회
sql-service.query: SELECT CASE AA.TREE_LEVEL WHEN 0 THEN '굴림,9,bold' END AS FONT_COL ,CASE AA.TREE_LEVEL WHEN 0 THEN '#666666' END AS FONT_CLR ,CASE AA.LEAF_YN WHEN 'Y' THEN '0' ELSE '2' END ASIMG_COL ,TREE_LEVEL ,PARENT_SEQNO AS MENU_SEQNO ,ID ,AUTH ,CAPTION ,LEAF_YN ,SUMMARY ,URL ,POPUP_YN ,PARENT_ID ,CHILD_SEQNO FROM( SELECT CHILD.MENU_LEVEL TREE_LEVEL ,CHILD.MENU_SEQNO ,CHILD.MENU_ID ID ,CHILD.AUTHORITY_CD AUTH ,CHILD.CAPTION CAPTION ,CHILD.LEAF_YN LEAF_YN ,CHILD.SUMMARY SUMMARY ,CHILD.ACTION1 URL ,CASE CHILD.WINTYPE WHEN 'popup' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS POPUP_YN ,CHILD.PARENT_ID ,CHILD.CHILD_SEQNO ,CASE PARENT.MENU_SEQNO WHEN '' THEN CHILD.MENU_SEQNO ELSE PARENT.MENU_SEQNO END PARENT_SEQNO FROM ( SELECT MENU_ID ,MENU_LEVEL ,AUTHORITY_CD ,CAPTION ,ACTION1 ,EXPLAN ,SUMMARY ,PARENT_ID ,MENU_SEQNO ,LEAF_YN ,WINTYPE FROM MS_MENU_LIST WHERE LEAF_YN='N' AND USE_YN = 'Y' AND CHARINDEX(?authority_cd, AUTHORITY_CD) > 0 ) PARENT RIGHT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT MENU_ID ,MENU_LEVEL ,AUTHORITY_CD ,CAPTION ,ACTION1 ,EXPLAN ,SUMMARY ,PARENT_ID ,MENU_SEQNO ,LEAF_YN ,WINTYPE ,CASE PARENT_ID WHEN 0 THEN MENU_ID ELSE PARENT_ID END PARENT ,CASE LEAF_YN WHEN 'N' THEN 0 ELSE MENU_SEQNO end as CHILD_SEQNO FROM MS_MENU_LIST WHERE USE_YN = 'Y' AND CHARINDEX(?authority_cd, AUTHORITY_CD) > 0 ) CHILD ON CHILD.PARENT = PARENT.MENU_ID ) AA ORDER BY PARENT_SEQNO ,CHILD_SEQNO

sql-service.name: codeutil_getcode
sql-service.query: SELECT * FROM MS_CODEBOOK WHERE CODE_TYPE = ?code_type AND CODE_ID <> 'KB00' AND CODE_ID <> '00' ?useyn ORDER BY CONVERT(INT,SORT_KEY),CODE_ID

sql-service.name: codeutil_getchildcode
sql-service.query: SELECT * FROM cs_codebook WHERE PARENT_TYPE = ?parent_type AND PARENT_ID = ?parent_id AND CODE_ID <> 'KB00' AND CODE_ID <> '00' ORDER BY CONVERT(INT,SORT_KEY), CODE_ID

sql-service.name: cs.com.deptlist.sel
sql-service.query: SELECT 0 CHK_VAL, CASE WHEN DEPT_TYPE = 01 THEN 0 WHEN DEPT_TYPE = 02 THEN 1 WHEN DEPT_TYPE = 03 THEN 2 WHEN DEPT_TYPE = 04 THEN 3 END DEPT_LEVEL, -- A.DEPT_LEVEL, A.SORT_NO, LTRIM(A.ORG1_CD) DEPT0_CD, LTRIM(A.ORG2_CD) DEPT1_CD, LTRIM(A.ORG3_CD) DEPT2_CD, LTRIM(A.ORG4_CD) DEPT3_CD, ( SELECT DEPT_NAME FROM MS_DEPT WHERE DEPT_CD = A.ORG1_CD ) AS DEPT0_NAME, ( SELECT DEPT_NAME FROM MS_DEPT WHERE DEPT_CD = A.ORG2_CD ) AS DEPT1_NAME, ( SELECT DEPT_NAME FROM MS_DEPT WHERE DEPT_CD = A.ORG3_CD ) AS DEPT2_NAME, ( SELECT DEPT_NAME FROM MS_DEPT WHERE DEPT_CD = A.ORG4_CD ) AS DEPT3_NAME, SORT_NO AS ANL_USE_YN FROM MS_DEPT A -- WHERE DEPT_LEVEL > 0 WHERE DEPT_TYPE IN ('02','03','04') AND A.USE_YN = 'Y' ?filter ?filter2 ORDER BY DEPT_LEVEL,A.DEPT_CD

condition.value: AND A.ORG2_CD IN (SELECT CODE_ID FROM MS_CODEBOOK WHERE CODE_TYPE = 'SYS002' AND CODE_ID NOT IN ('KB00','00') AND USE_YN = 'Y')

sql-service.name: cs.com.org_user
sql-service.query: SELECT USER_ID AS CODEID ,USER_NAME + ' (' + EMP_NO + ')' CODENAME ,'%' AS ETC1 ,DEPT_CD AS DEPT_CODE ,USER_GRADE_CD AS USER_GRADE ,100 - USER_GRADE_CD AS GRADE_ORDER ,EMP_NO AS EMP_NO FROM ms_usermaster WHERE 1=1 AND USE_YN = 'Y' AND EMP_NO IS NOT NULL ?deptcd ?userid ORDER BY ?orderby

sql-service.name: cs.com.get.cnsl
sql-service.query: SELECT CNSL_CD_SEQ , MAIN_CNSL_CD CNSL1_CD , SUB_CNSL_CD CNSL2_CD , DTL_CNSL_CD CNSL3_CD , MAIN_CNSL_CD_NM CNSL1_NM , SUB_CNSL_CD_NM CNSL2_NM , DTL_CNSL_CD_NM CNSL3_NM , CNSL_LVL , DSAT_CL_CD , COMP_GUBUN FROM vs_cnsl_code WHERE USE_YN='Y' ORDER BY CONVERT(INTEGER, CNSL_CD_SEQ)

sql-service.name: cs.com.setDate_holiday.sel
sql-service.query: SELECT SOLAR FROM MS_HOLIDAY_INFO WHERE (WEEKNAM IN ('토','일') OR DETAIL IS NOT NULL) AND SOLAR BETWEEN ?sdate AND ?edate

sql-service.name: cs.main.help.sel
sql-service.query: SELECT A.MENU_ID AS MENU_ID, A.CAPTION AS CAPTION, A.EXPLAN AS DOCUMENT FROM ms_menu_list A WHERE A.MENU_ID = ?menuid;

sql-service.name: cs.common.getContents.sel
sql-service.query: SELECT UCID, STT_SENT, (SELECT ENC_FLAG FROM MS_STT_RSLT_MERGE WHERE UCID = ?UCID) AS ENC_FLAG, RXTX_GB FROM ms_stt_rslt WHERE UCID = ?UCID ORDER BY UCID, STT_SENT_ID ASC

sql-service.name: cs.com.getProduct.sel
sql-service.query: SELECT c.ETC1 AS ISTP_CD, c.ETC2 AS ISTP_NM, p.PROD_CD AS PROD_CD, p.PROD_NM AS PROD_NM FROM ms_codebook c, ms_product p WHERE c.CODE_ID = p.PROD_CD and c.CODE_TYPE='COM004' AND P.USE_YN = 'Y' --and C.USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY PROD_CD ASC

sql-service.name: cs.com.getistpcd.sel
sql-service.query: SELECT c.ETC1 AS ISTP_CD, c.ETC2 AS ISTP_NM FROM ms_codebook c, ms_product p WHERE c.CODE_ID = p.PROD_CD AND P.USE_YN = 'Y' --and C.USE_YN = 'Y' and c.CODE_TYPE='COM004' GROUP BY ETC1, ETC2 ORDER BY ISTP_CD ASC

sql-service.name: cs.com.getQcOrg.sel
sql-service.query: SELECT DEPT_CD AS QC_ORG_CD, DEPT_NAME AS QC_ORG_NM FROM MS_DEPT WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE DEPT_CD IN ( SELECT ETC1 FROM MS_CODEBOOK WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE CODE_TYPE ='SYS140' AND CODE_ID <> '00' AND USE_YN = 'Y' ) ?use_yn ORDER BY DEPT_CD ASC

sql-service.name: cs.com.getQcUser.sel
sql-service.query: SELECT DEPT_CD AS QC_ORG_CD, DEPT_NM AS QC_ORG_NM, USER_ID AS QC_USER_ID, USER_NAME + ' (' + USER_ID + ')' AS QC_USER_NM FROM VW_USERMASTER WHERE ORG3_CD IN ( SELECT ETC1 FROM MS_CODEBOOK WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE CODE_TYPE ='SYS140' AND CODE_ID <> '00' AND USE_YN = 'Y' ) ?use_yn ORDER BY USER_ID ASC, DEPT_CD ASC
